baseline.scope: Observed cross-platform component/contracts/control evidence; no full release criterion PASS is inferred.

rules: All criteria begin UNKNOWN/not_run; a plan is not an execution receipt.
Preserve all 131 system catalogue criterion IDs and their original requirements.
Missing/partial/skip/UNKNOWN/ERROR cannot satisfy a mandatory criterion.
Unsupported required feature is not NOT_APPLICABLE.
Scenario pass, fixture pass, corpus control pass and live task success are different verdict scopes.
G7 packaging publication is a post-G6 operation; preliminary asset verification may use unpublished drafts.
Private holdout raw cases remain outside agent rights; public output contains only permitted aggregates.
Five-target package/floor criteria need one exact target ID receipt per native_targets entry; three OS-family receipts are insufficient.
Calibration clean blockers include blocking UNKNOWN/Abstain/HOLD/malformed/timeout; separate reporting never excludes them.
Stable3/3 uses three preassigned PRIMARY IDs; primary ERROR is failure; diagnostic retry cannot replace primary.
Q08-Q10 common behavioral scores apply equally; H-only subsystem proof is separate and cannot automatically fail B0/B1.
Runtime/instrumentation/guest/package/version are frozen before G5; G6 only tests exact accepted assets.
